{{Otheruses|Eclipse}}
An '''eclipse''' was a type of astronomical event. During the [[Galactic War]], a rare [[Moon/Legends|lunar]] eclipse was prophesized to reveal a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shalyvane]] where the [[Deity/Legends|deity]] [[Kavaan]] was believed to have left [[Gender/Legends|his]] mark.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Provider of the Sun}}</ref> [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]] experienced a [[Star/Legends|solar]] eclipse every seventy-six years, which (according to legend) revealed a hidden tomb of the first settler, which may have had hidden treasures.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Stare into the Sun}}</ref>

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] once witnessed a total solar eclipse on a world, resulting in diffuse light in the middle of the day and natural life to act as if it were sunset.
